The studio

Artistic expression.
Practical purpose.

Volthera Studio helps game developers save development time with ready-made VFX for Unity. Drawing on advanced expertise in real-time visual effects, we focus on carefully crafted effects that support gameplay feedback and atmosphere.

Our goal is simple: give developers more room to create, experiment, and bring their own ideas to life.
